instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: I was only nervous, not mad, and I knew it. My illness made all my senses stronger, especially my hearing. I could hear everything in heaven and on earth. Judge how calmly I tell you this whole story. I loved the old man who shared my home. He never hurt me, and I wanted none of his money. But his pale blue eye had a thin covering, like a vulture's. It froze my blood. I would kill him and close that eye forever. For seven nights, I slowly opened his door at midnight. I put my head inside, carrying a covered lantern. I let a thin line of light reach his eye. The eye was closed every time. I hated the eye, not him, and could not act. Every morning, I spoke to him warmly.
